description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of a custom log appender called MemoryAppender in the OpenMRS logging framework. It includes setup and teardown methods, and multiple tests to check that log messages are correctly appended and that buffer size limits are enforced.

classes.name: MemoryAppenderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the custom MemoryAppender in the OpenMRS logging system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes MemoryAppender and logger instances before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Removes the appender and stops the MemoryAppender after each test, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: memoryAppender_shouldAppendAMessage
methods.description: Tests that a single log message is correctly appended to the MemoryAppender.

methods.name: memoryAppender_shouldAppendMultipleMessages
methods.description: Checks that multiple log messages are accumulated properly in the MemoryAppender.

methods.name: memoryAppender_shouldOnlyKeepBufferSizeItems
methods.description: Verifies that MemoryAppender respects the buffer size limit by only keeping the most recent entries.

methods.name: setupLogger
methods.description: Configures the logger to use the MemoryAppender and sets logging level.
